ios.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Moss reads your age, sex, height and weight from Health for your targets; your steps, water, mindful minutes and sleep to light up those habits on their own (your steps also estimate your night if you don’t have a watch); and what your watch measures at night for the Sleep section.
ios.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Moss never writes to Health: it only reads the data you choose.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Moss uses the camera to read the barcode and the nutrition label of what you eat, and for a meal photo if you want one. The photos never leave your phone.
ios.NSMotionUsageDescription: Without a watch, Moss uses your phone’s motion to estimate when you slept. The motion never leaves your phone: only the estimated time is saved.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Moss uses the microphone only while you say what you ate, to log it. Moss never saves the audio.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Moss turns what you say about your meal into text to log it, using Apple's speech recognition (on your phone when the language allows it). Moss never saves the audio.
